summary: Iteration 5 end-to-end tested. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass for Peringkat Kelas (admin/guru/siswa) and Ambang Kesukaran (GET/PUT settings + 400 on invalid + threshold-driven analytics relabel). Frontend: admin /admin/peringkat renders leaderboard-page with class selector, selecting Kelas X-A shows rank-row-1 Ani Siswa (avg 55.7); student /peringkat renders student-leaderboard with self highlighted '(Anda)' in Kelas X-A; nav-peringkat present; admin Hasil & Koreksi -> UH Matematika session -> Analitik Butir shows edit-threshold-btn, dialog easy-min-input/medium-min-input/save-threshold-btn work, saving 90/60 shows success toast 'Ambang kesukaran disimpan' and Ambang subtitle updates. issues: Recharts warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' logged repeatedly - non-blocking but should be addressed by setting minWidth/minHeight or fixed sizes on ResponsiveContainer parents.

action_items: Optional: fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer parent sizing to remove width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_class_leaderboard aggregates on the fly per request; fine for current scale but consider caching if student/attempt counts grow.
PUT /api/settings/difficulty accepts any float and only checks medium_min<easy_min; consider clamping to [0,100] to prevent nonsense values (e.g. -20 or 150).
server.py is very large (>1300 lines); consider splitting into routers for maintainability (auth, exam, analytics, leaderboard, settings).
